MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKEGGIS_WARNING_EVENT.pag:
Old Skeggi holds out a sword: Sköfnung, taken from the grave of King Hrólf Kraki. Twelve berserkers are said to have stood at that king's side.
As he handed it over, Skeggi warned again and again, so the tale goes:
"Never draw it where a woman is present. Never let the sun shine on its hilt. If a little snake creeps out from under the hilt, tilt the sword and let it creep back."
"A wound this sword makes will not heal unless it is rubbed with the Sköfnung stone."
Upgrade [gold]Sköfnung[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Sköfnung Stone[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Lose [red]{ChampionsHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Hrólf's Champions[/gold] to your deck.
Rub the Wound with the Stone

You draw the sword in the shade. A little snake slips out from under the hilt, then quietly back. You tie the stone to your belt; from now on it goes wherever the sword goes.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
As you draw it, the blade howls like the war cry of the men who once guarded a king. It has cut your palm.
You rub the stone over the cut the sword gave you. Slowly, the open wound closes.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.title: Moye's Hair
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.IN:
The furnace roars, yet the iron will not melt.
Moye, wife of the smith Ganjiang, is said to have cut off her hair and nails and thrown them into the fire. When the children worked the bellows, the iron melted at last, and the couple gave the two swords their own names.
Another tale is told as well. Ganjiang gave the king only the female sword, hid the male one, and was put to death for it. Years later his son Chi found the sword, and gave a stranger his own head and the sword so that the stranger would avenge him.
Lose [red]{HairMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Upgrade [gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Hidden Blade[/gold] to your deck.
Lose [red]{VengeanceHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Vengeance[/gold] to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.HA:
Hair and nails flare up in the fire, and only then does the molten iron run. Something of you has gone into the blade.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.HI: You show one sword and hide the other deep. The day to draw it will come.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.VE: The price was not light. In return, the sword will not forget its enemy's neck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.title: The Silver Arm
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.IN:
The sword of Nuada, brought from Findias. Once it was drawn from its sheath, they say, no one escaped it.
Yet Nuada lost his arm fighting the Fir Bolg. A blemished man could not be king, so he gave up the throne.
Dian Cécht the physician, with Credne the smith, made him an arm of silver that moved like a living one, so the story goes.
Pay [gold]{SilverGold}[/gold] Gold. Upgrade [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Silver Arm[/gold] to your deck. Obtain the curse [red]Nuada's Lost Arm[/red].
Lose [red]{ThroneMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Remove a card from your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.SI:
Silver fingers close around the hilt. The blade's light burns brighter.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.AR: The silver arm moves as it should, but the empty place of the lost one remains.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.TH: You set down one thing you were holding. You are a little lighter, and a little weaker.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.title: Three Hills
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.I:
The last battle of the Cattle Raid of Cooley. Fergus, exiled from Ulster, fought for Connacht with Caladbolg in hand.
When he struck at his old king Conchobar, the king's shield Ochain screamed, and all the shields of Ulster screamed with it, so the tale goes.
Cormac, the king's son, begged him to spare his king. Fergus turned his blade aside and cut the tops off three hills.
And when Cú Chulainn came, Fergus kept his old promise and led his men from the field.
Upgrade [gold]Caladbolg[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Shield of the Unstruck King[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Lose [red]{OchainHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Intimidate[/gold] to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.H:
The blade grows as if to touch the sky, and the hilltops fall away. The shield of the king you never struck still floats before your eyes.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.O: The shield screams, and every shield around it answers. Your ears ring. You keep that sound in the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.W: You sheathe your sword and turn from the field. Behind you, the tide of battle turns.
